Welcome…

The Barnt Green Social Club is a friendly, locally run Club situated in the village of Barnt Green, Worcestershire.

Whether you’re wanting to enjoy a quiet drink with friends, or indulge yourself in one of our themed evenings, we’ve got something for everyone.  From live music to summer BBQ’s and Treasure Hunts around the local lanes to quiz nights; our Club offers it all.
